specification.objective: Repair the Kanban widget-test harness and add executable geometry, empty-board, input, and real drawer-navigation probes without changing production behavior. The increment must distinguish framework-level layout/input correctness from the browser-only paint/hit-test defect before any further Kanban redesign.

requirements.statement: The invalid assertion that WorkspaceNavigationDrawer is mounted while Scaffold.drawer is closed must be replaced with an assertion against the configured Scaffold.drawer widget, because Scaffold mounts drawer contents lazily.

A wide-viewport fixture matching the observed one-column/zero-card runtime state must verify that the project content begins below the AppBar, KanbanBoardView has positive bounded geometry, the empty lane renders, and no Flutter exception is raised.
The focused fixture must dispatch a real tap to the visible create-column control and prove that the expected column dialog opens.

The real WorkspaceNavigationDrawer path must be exercised through openDrawer -> Kanban tap -> pushReplacement, proving that navigation reaches ProjectKanbanPage rather than only mounting the page directly in tests.
Existing virtualized list/drag assertions and narrow-viewport coverage must remain intact.
No production Dart, backend, API, renderer/bootstrap, dependency, or workflow file may change in this diagnostic increment.
Passing widget tests are evidence only for framework-level widget geometry and dispatch; they must not be represented as proof that the browser runtime rendering defect is fixed.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The wide page test reads Scaffold.drawer and confirms it is a WorkspaceNavigationDrawer while the closed drawer remains absent from the mounted subtree.

With one column and zero cards, the AppBar, toolbar text, KanbanBoardView, lane label 'A fazer (0)', and 'Solte um card aqui' all have valid rendered geometry; the toolbar starts below the AppBar and the board height is greater than zero.
Tapping the visible 'Coluna' action opens the 'Nova coluna' dialog.
Opening WorkspaceNavigationDrawer and tapping its 'Kanban' entry replaces the current route with ProjectKanbanPage.
The existing virtualized columns/card-slot test and narrow viewport test continue to pass.
The commit changes only frontend/test/features/projects/presentation/project_kanban_page_test.dart and this versioned Change Contract.
The Change Contract explicitly keeps browser runtime resolution out of scope; this increment produces diagnostic evidence only and does not claim Chrome/Firefox rendering is fixed.

invariants.statement: The Kanban production widget tree at baseline a19f6962 remains byte-for-byte unchanged by this increment.
Backend Kanban persistence, authorization, optimistic concurrency, card identity, ordering, and API contracts are unchanged.
Browser-specific CanvasKit policy is not revised in this increment.
The current browser defect is still considered unresolved until the user re-tests the runtime after a causal production change.

forbidden_states.statement: Production layout offsets, padding compensation, transforms, renderer settings, or drag/drop code are changed before geometry evidence identifies the failing boundary.
The diagnostic asserts that a closed Scaffold drawer must already be mounted.
A passing Flutter widget test is reported as proof that Chrome/Firefox rendering is fixed.
The diagnostic fixture diverges from the observed one-column/zero-card state when validating empty-board geometry.

inputs.statement: Baseline feature/tasks-kanban commit a19f6962a8259c9ebd89fbe9f5179d7f07d3cf3d with tree 506dfa65efd2e298faa6ca3a4af3c4ca60e53a02.
Observed browser state: one Kanban column, zero cards, project/metrics loaded, board surface not visibly painted as expected, same behavior in Firefox and Chrome.
Current CI failure: project_kanban_page_test expects a lazily mounted WorkspaceNavigationDrawer while the drawer is closed.

outputs.statement: A green, causally useful widget-test harness that measures geometry and input dispatch instead of only widget presence.
A real drawer-navigation probe covering the route transition used by the application.
Evidence that can classify a future runtime mismatch as layout/constraints, paint/compositor, or hit-testing rather than continuing component redesign by assumption.

failure_semantics.statement: If the focused widget test fails geometry assertions, the divergence is within the Flutter layout/widget boundary and production diagnosis must continue there before browser-renderer hypotheses.

If the focused widget tests pass but the browser still reproduces the defect, the evidence shifts toward web paint/compositor/runtime or browser hit-testing rather than Kanban state/layout construction.
If drawer navigation does not reach ProjectKanbanPage, the real route transition becomes the primary failing boundary.
